d: a word used to describe twelve units

d: say something deserves to be chosen

d: a bunch of flowers tied together

d: kind of

vi: Sáng nay tôi hơi vội một chút.

d: a problem or difficult situation

d: a clause in an insurance policy that relieves the

d: the extent of the protection provided by insurance

d: in terms of, about

d: a payment made everytime a medical service is need

d: the medicine or remedy ordered by a physician for a patient

vi: Bác sĩ kê cho tôi đơn thuốc kháng sinh và dặn uống hai lần mỗi ngày.

d: certain services that an insurance company will not cover in the plan
ex: The insurance company told me that dental work is an exclusion in my plan.

d: the prevention and treatment of illness and the preservation of well-being through the services offered by the health professions
ex: I wish our company or country provided us with healthcare.

d: the amount paid for an insurance policy, often in installments

vi: Tôi trả phí bảo hiểm sức khỏe hằng tháng khoảng hai trăm đô la.

d: After the deductible is exceeded, it is when the insured must also pay a percentage of the total cost of services while the insurance company pays the rest. It can be used instead of or in addition to copays.

vi: Với bảo hiểm đồng chi trả, tôi trả hai mươi phần trăm hóa đơn bệnh viện và bảo hiểm trả phần còn lại.
